transition_refinement: Add justified points between adjacent cells when the signed effect changes; use at least 10 repetitions near a candidate transition.

prompt_control.method: Generate and verify exact token lengths with the pinned model tokenizer
prompt_control.independent_unit: one fresh vLLM server process for one model/workload/TP/concurrency/repetition cell

robustness_criterion: A favorable paired-repetition mean delta must have a 95% confidence interval excluding zero; otherwise the cell is inconclusive/no robust crossover.

standardized_crosscheck.alternate: vllm bench serve only if separately justified
standardized_crosscheck.dependency_boundary: separate virtual environment and process; never a lightweight SDK dependency or canonical-server runtime mutation
standardized_crosscheck.metric_warning: Do not equate TTFT/TPOT/ITL definitions across tools without explicit reconciliation.
